name: Nikuyoku Devil Saimin
source:
Today too, ``Senjiro'' hides in the changing room and watches the girls change clothes.
Also there is the student president of the school, Reika, who stands out.
Reika is sensitive to Senjiro's erotic odor, as if it is reflected in her eyes.
Pointing to the blind spot where Senjiro is hiding,
"You cockroach! Shut up!" she yelled.
However, Senjiro continues to peek out of spite.
There, Reika chanted a certain spell to Senjiro.
Then, Senjiro's body was bound, and the blood vessels in his body became hot like magma.
His brain feels as good as when he ejaculates.
... Immediately after, Senjiro loses consciousness.

The whole class agrees with Reika's words, and even her female teacher supports Reika and despises Senjiro.

"Reika! Eventually, your heart and body will be mine! If I want, you can show off your beautiful skin! And...!"
He continued to make obscene remarks that would be difficult to post here.

This remark became an order, and...oh my god! ?
In the middle of everyone, Reika starts taking off her uniform!
Neither she nor Reika know what she's doing, and she tries to suppress her urges, saying, "Yay!? No!"
However, due to her irresistible compulsion, she finally did it! She got naked in front of everyone!

Realizing that the true nature of her sexual harassment is mental control by an evil spirit, Senjiro orders Reika to sexualize her as he pleases.
Reika, on the other hand, tries her best to escape from the harassment.
However, Senjiro's soul continues to be sucked out while being poisoned by evil spirits, and Reika's inner feelings progress to hellish suffering...
In the end, both of them are forced to make the ultimate choice.
